title: Maths #5 · Where derivatives come from: chord → tangent (copy of @mathsy.uk, narrated)

captions.instagram:
Where do derivatives really come from? 🤔

Class 11 Maths · Limits and Derivatives
Maths, visualised #5

Take two points on a curve, h apart. The line through them climbs f(x + h) − f(x) over a distance h.
Let h shrink towards 0 and that line turns into the tangent at x.
The slope it settles on is the derivative: f′(x) = lim h→0 [f(x + h) − f(x)] / h
"Find the derivative from first principles" is a regular Class 11 exam question, and the idea under every calculus PYQ.
